scripts.build: rm -rf ../token-storage && npm run data && npm run charts && slidev build token-storage.md --base /token-storage/ --out ../token-storage
scripts.export: echo 'Run: pnpm dev, then open http://localhost:3030/export (browser exporter, no playwright needed)'
scripts.charts: rm -rf public/charts && for c in ratio corpora chunk-ratio chunk-encode ood ngram; do CHART=$c vite build --config charts/vite.config.mjs || exit 1; done
